root_text:
What role does #China play on #Slovak social media? 📱

Our analysis shows 🇨🇳 plays a relatively marginal role. Discussions mostly focus on foreign policy under PM Fico, the HMPV virus, and 🇸🇰 influencers sharing their trips ✈️ to China.

✍️
